Privacy Policy

DRAFT: have this reviewed before going live. Last updated 2026-10-20.

What we collect

  • Email and billing details you give Stripe at checkout (we receive your email and purchase record, not card numbers).
  • Your email address if you sign up for the free Landing Page Kit, with the date you signed up.
  • Basic server logs (IP address, user agent) for security.

Done-for-you service clients

If you buy a done-for-you service, we also hold what you give us to run it (such as company lists, content sources, website or publishing credentials) and the reports we produce for you. We use it only to provide the service, keep it on our own server with access limited to us, and delete it within 30 days after the service ends.

Lead generation reports contain business contact details (such as names, work emails and phone numbers) published on public company websites. We collect these on our client's behalf and only for that client. If your details appear in a report and you want them removed, email us and we will delete them and tell the client.

How we use it

To deliver your purchase, send receipts, prevent fraud and provide support. We do not sell personal data.

Email signups

When you sign up for the free Landing Page Kit, we may send you occasional news about new templates and tools. Every such email tells you how to unsubscribe, or you can email us at any time to unsubscribe and have your address deleted.

Processors

Stripe (payments), Resend (email delivery, including service reports), our hosting provider and storage provider. Each processes data under its own privacy terms.

Your rights

Email info@snowseasonstech.net to request access or deletion, subject to record-keeping duties.
